messages:
ashley_partnerships: Quick thread to align on vendor timelines (H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi), SI enablement, marketplace SKUs, and embargo windows. Drop firm dates and blockers pls.

michelle_pm: Marketing needs embargo date + 3 bullet feature matrix for listing by Apr 26.

omar_eng: From eng: tests we need = driver boot, int8 perf, kv-cache long-context, and multi-node link tests. Also need firmware notes for Gaudi.

nvidia_rep: H200 validation boards available to partners Apr 24, planned GA May 6. We require signed transfer form and secure wipe on return. Embargo: public after May 7.

amd_rep: MI300 early boards Apr 28; public availability target May 10. We'll send runtime notes Apr 24 and flag a minor context-size driver fix in next RC.

infra_bot: infra-bot: Lab rack reservation confirmed 2026-04-24 -> 2026-04-29, 2 racks. Power check: PDUs N+1 OK.

omar_eng: Can marketplace get a default billing SKU by Apr 25? Also propose separate SKUs for H-class vs B-class due to perf diff.

michelle_pm: Separate SKUs ok. Also request a 1-paragraph fallback policy for FAQ (H200 -> H100 fallback) by Apr 26.

ashley_partnerships: SI enablement: propose Apr 28 90-min session (hands-on). Omar, can you lead?

omar_eng: Yes. I'll prepare a 1-page SI quickstart + 2-slide TL;DR by Apr 26 and a 1-page runbook for failover/telemetry/rollback by Apr 23.

nvidia_rep: Note: telemetry must be opt-in for partner diagnostics pre-GA.

amd_rep: We'll deliver MI300 runtime notes and power/thermal guidance Apr 22.

ashley_partnerships: Actions:
- nvidia_rep: transfer form + manifest (due Apr 20)
- amd_rep: runtime notes + bug note (due Apr 24)
- omar_eng: runbook + SI slides (due Apr 23/26)
- marketplace: SKU template (due Apr 25)
- infra_bot: confirm billing SKU mapping + rack PDU schedule (due Apr 21)

ashley_partnerships: Tentative public announcement target May 8 (gives partners time after GA). If any party needs a different embargo, flag now.

michelle_pm: May 8 works. I'll schedule a go/no-go Apr 27 09:30am PT.

ashley_partnerships: Thanks all. Keep updates here and ping if anything slips. :thumbsup:
